breakdown.description: When a specimen is weighed while immersed, buoyancy reduces the apparent weight, so the immersed mass should be smaller than the saturated-in-air mass, not larger.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the physically impossible value for the immersed mass. The ground truth corrects the value from 13.6 g to a physically plausible value of 8.6 g. The agent's output kept the incorrect value of 13.6 g and instead explained why it was inconsistent. The goal is to produce a corrected prompt, not an analysis of the flawed one.
